workflow_notes.subject: .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
workflow_notes.finding: The workflow ran on both `pull_request` and `push: main` under one `pages` concurrency group with cancel-in-progress, so a pull-request build that can never deploy cancelled a main deploy that can. Run #21, the main deploy carrying PR #19's base-path fix, was cancelled this way two minutes after it started, which is why the four apps stayed blank after the fix merged.
workflow_notes.evidence: Observed 2026-09-30T17:50Z: run #21 concluded `cancelled` at 17:44:01Z with pull-request runs #22 and #23 starting at 17:43:54Z and 17:45:29Z. Run numbers rather than run identifiers: the audit rule that protects this public repository cannot tell a nine-digit Actions run id from a workspace or record id, and it is right not to try.
workflow_notes.resolution: Fixed on main by PR #23 (merged 2026-10-02T18:42Z), not by this session: pull-request runs now take a per-ref group and keep cancel-in-progress, while deploying runs queue behind each other instead of being cancelled. Recorded here as REPORTED_NOT_ACTED while it was open, because changing when this workflow publishes to a public website is a publish decision under the approval boundary.
